source_message:
fix: protect-soul.sh — SOUL_PROTECTED user-scoped + selective sudo for chattr/root paths

- SOUL_PROTECTED: /root/.openclaw-moa/ → /home/mmber/.openclaw-moa/soul-protected/
  (user-owned, writable by mmber without root)
- cmd_update: mkdir -p for new user path
- cmd_deploy/verify/unlock: sudo only for WORKSPACE_ROOT (root-owned) and all chattr calls
- deploy-gap1-auto-verify.sh: revert sudo bash → bash (protect-soul.sh handles sudo internally)
- docs/MEMORY.md: update canonical source path
- docs/SOUL-PROTECTION.md: update path table and architecture note
